caption: The drawing consists of two detailed pencil illustrations of spoons, both viewed from above and arranged horizontally, one above the other, against a plain, light-colored background. Each spoon has an elongated oval bowl and a gently tapering handle. The top spoon shows some ornate detail and a monogram or engraved initials on the end of the handle. The lower spoon has hallmarks or stamped writing on its handle. Below the two main spoon illustrations, there is a smaller inset drawing depicting the outline and dimensions of a spoon, with measured labels, all drawn in fine lines. The entire composition is enclosed within a lightly drawn rectangular border, and there is handwriting near the lower right corner indicating the scale (3/4 = 1’) and a signature or name.
title: Silver Spoon
